headlines.text: On a Friday in 2022, back when Shawn Spears stepped back through the curtain after just under 5 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Castagnoli & Moxley kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.60.
